d: Jharkhand men matdata suchi ke vishesh gahan punrikshan (SIR) ki prakriya ko lekar samaysima barha di gaee hai. ab 15 disanbar tak notis, dave aur aapattiyon ka niptara kiya jaega, jabki 22 disanbar ko phainal matdata suchi prakashit hogi. nirvachan adhikariyon ke mutabik, jin matdataon ke dastavejon ka satyapan baki hai, unki prakriya puri karne ke lie atirikt samay diya gaya hai. buth star par kainp lagakar matdataon ka satyapan kiya ja raha hai. sath hi ghar-ghar jakar chhute hue matdataon ki jankari bhi jutaee ja rahi hai. adhikariyon ne apil ki hai ki 18 varsh ki aayu puri kar chuke…
